2607.13569.title: GHR-VLM: Making Zero-Shot Transit Video Analytics Realizable with Grounded Hybrid Reasoning
2607.13569.paper_summary: Transit video understanding can provide valuable fine-grained data that conventional passenger counters and fare systems cannot capture. However, supervised video models require task-specific annotations, while applying vision-language models (VLMs) directly to long onboard videos is unreliable and costly. To leverage the complementary strengths of both approaches, we propose GHR-VLM, a visual grounded hybrid reasoning framework for zero-shot transit-bus video analytics. It is motivated by the observation that explicit visual grounding can improve VLM reasoning by converting long surveillance streams into compact, passenger-centered spatiotemporal evidence. Specifically, we propose an edge-cloud design in which a lightweight edge-based monitor continuously tracks door status and segments passenger clips. A backend VLM then identifies boarding passengers and classifies payment behavior through a two-stage coarse-to-fine refinement of spatiotemporal evidence. By invoking the VLM only on grounded passenger clips and contact sheets, GHR-VLM reduces cloud inference, avoids payment-specific training data, and supplies the localized evidence that VLMs otherwise struggle to identify. Evaluation on 486 minutes of real-world bus surveillance video demonstrates the potential of grounded edge-cloud reasoning for passenger-level payment analytics while highlighting the challenges posed by degraded video conditions.
2607.13569.paper_summary_zh: 公共交通視頻理解可以提供傳統乘客計數器和票價系統無法捕捉的有價值的細粒度數據。<lb/>然而，監督式視頻模型需要特定任務的標註，而直接將視覺-語言模型（VLM）應用於長時間的車載視頻則不可靠且成本高昂。<lb/>為了利用這兩種方法的互補優勢，我們提出了GHR-VLM，一種針對零樣本公共汽車視頻分析的視覺基礎混合推理框架。<lb/>這一框架的動機在於觀察到顯式視覺基礎可以通過將長期監控流轉換為緊湊的以乘客為中心的時空證據來改善VLM推理。<lb/>具體而言，我們提出了一種邊緣-雲設計，其中一個輕量級的邊緣監控器持續跟踪門狀態並分割乘客片段。<lb/>然後，後端VLM通過對時空證據進行兩階段的粗到細的精煉來識別上車乘客並分類支付行為。<lb/>通過僅在基於乘客的片段和聯絡表上調用VLM，GHR-VLM減少了雲端推斷，避免了特定支付的訓練數據，並提供了VLM通常難以識別的本地化證據。<lb/>對486分鐘的真實世界公交監控視頻的評估展示了基於邊緣-雲推理的乘客級支付分析的潛力，同時突顯了劣化視頻條件所帶來的挑戰。
